pullRequest.title: Add the workspace, the board model and an offline gh-style CLI
pullRequest.body:
Step 1 of docs/design.md (cgwalters-forge/tracker#447): three crates, the core types with versioned snapshot and plan schemas, one rule (an item with no Status gets a proposed Triage status), and an offline CLI that also answers to `gh-agent-board`. Plus CI and a README in a second commit.

The first commit was written by a remote agent run (opencode, gpt-6.1-sol, [run 37706035749](https://github.com/bootc-dev/cgwalters-devspace-sandbox/actions/runs/37706035749)). The runner's own check refused its patch because it adds `.gitignore`, a protected path there, so the coordinator applied it by hand after checking it for binaries, symlinks, mode changes and secret-shaped strings (13 files, none). It has had no real review yet: treat it as unreviewed.

Known before review: about 22 `unwrap` or `expect` calls outside tests, which the project's rules do not allow.
